overview: A specialised text input for email address entry, built on top of `InputText`. It renders an `<input type="email">` element, which provides browser-native email validation, and includes a clear (X) action button that empties the field when clicked. Use this component whenever the expected value is an email address; for plain text use `InputText` instead.

whenToUse: When collecting an email address from a user
When browser-native email format validation is desired without additional custom logic
do: Always pair with a visible label or `aria-label` so screen readers identify the field as an email input
Use the `error` prop to signal invalid or unrecognised email addresses after server-side validation
dont: Use this component for general text input - use `InputText` instead
Rely solely on browser validation for critical email flows - always validate server-side as well
